title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1966-10-07

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a rare 1966 show with standout Stealin', Cream Puff War and Little Schoolgirl performances, though the exact date/venue is hotly disputed.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers solid 1966 sound‑board quality that lets listeners enjoy rare early versions of “Stealin’”, “Cream Puff War” and “Little Schoolgirl”.  While many fans praise Jerry’s unique licks and the overall energy, a persistent debate over whether the concert actually took place at Winterland or was moved to the Fillmore tempers enthusiasm.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the musical performance and sound highly (4‑5 stars), but a sizable minority give 0‑1 stars due to doubts about the concert’s authenticity, leading to an overall strong rating with moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note the tape is well‑cut for its era and sounds good overall; a few mention a lack of vocal clarity on one track, but no major dropouts or distortion are reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A short three‑song set of early material that flows smoothly and showcases rare performances, despite the limited length.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Several reviewers highlight Jerry's unique licks on Stealin' and his overall guitar work as exceptional.
